description: Re-check one page and commit: pass resolves the finding as fix-applied; else records the verdict and leaves it open. Optional expect (≤5 unique fields: title, meta_description, canonical, h1, meta_robots) reads them from the same live fetch and returns fieldChecks/implementationVerified; a mismatch does not keep the finding open and is not a ranking result. Research block (SERP/AIO per query, ≤3, read-only) is context, not verification; never report it as the fix's effect. Writes no audit run. Requires audits:write; confirm + unique idempotencyKey; without confirm it previews; same key replays 24h.
name: verify_fix
title: Verify a fix and close the finding
